title: Strong Complementarity For Linear Programming
body_html:
Strong Complementarity For Linear Programming

If a primal linear program and its dual are feasible, then there exist optimal solutions $(x,u)$ satisfying strict complementary slackness: $$ A_i x-b_i>0 \Longleftrightarrow u_i=0 $$ and $$ c_j-uA_j>0 \Longleftrightarrow x_j=0. $$
